copper.name: Copper
copper.basis: Labor, industrial adjustment and price incidence. Warm bronze rather than pink clay.

forest.name: Forest
forest.basis: Physical resources, ecosystem constraints and welfare accounting. A warmer leaf-green field.

estuary.name: Estuary
estuary.basis: Measurement systems, model comparability and interconnected evidence. A cooler blue field.

lichen.name: Lichen
lichen.basis: Material inputs, production processes and land or resource efficiency; the existing journal figure wash.

sage.name: Sage
sage.basis: Adaptation, behavioral adjustment and responses over time.

pollen.name: Pollen
pollen.basis: Thresholds, incentives, decision margins and the option value of waiting.

slate.name: Slate
slate.basis: Identification, institutional comparison and the separation of an estimand from its estimator.

tidal.name: Tidal
tidal.basis: Networks, shared infrastructure, transmission channels and system interdependence.

selectionRule: An editor selects one of eight journal-derived color families using the reading's focal economic object, lead graphic or research task, and records a specific rationale. Adjacent readings inform a tie-break between equally suitable choices. The renderer never rotates colors or guesses from keywords.
inheritanceRule: The color profile belongs to the reading. Every feature, including detached panels separated by standard sections, inherits the same background and border accent.
